mapper.select: /*selectMasterWmCoGoodsCodePopList*/ SELECT TRIM(BT.IMGFILE_DIR) IMGFILE_DIR, TRIM(BT.IMGFILE_NAME) IMGFILE_NAME, BT.CATEGORY_TEXT, BT.CATEGORY_NO, DT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, DT.DESCRIPTION, DT.SPECIFICATION, BT.UNIT_MEASURE, BT.DELIVERY_LT, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND DT.ORIGIN_CODE = CODE) ORIGIN, BT.MAKER_NAME, BT.REMARK, DT.UNIT_PRICE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = DT.AGENT) AGENT_TEXT, DT.PROCESS_TYPE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M034' AND CODE = DT.PROCESS_TYPE AND FLAG = 'Y') AS PROCESS_TYPE_NAME, F_GET_LOGISTICS_FEE_INFO(DT.BELOW_COMORG_CODE, DT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, DT.PROCESS_TYPE, DT.AGENT, 0,'02', DT.ORIGIN_AGENT) AS LOGISTICS_RATE, F_GET_LOGISTICS_FEE_INFO(DT.BELOW_COMORG_CODE, DT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, DT.PROCESS_TYPE, DT.AGENT, 0,'03', DT.ORIGIN_AGENT) AS LOGIS_RATE_STATUS FROM ICOMBYIT BT, ICOMCQDT DT WHERE BT.BUYER = #{BYIT_COMORG_CODE} AND BT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{BUYER_ITEM_NO} AND BT.BUYER = DT.BUYER AND BT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = DT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND DT.CONTRACT_NO = #{CONTRACT_NO} AND DT.CONTRACT_SEQ = #{CONTRACT_SEQ} AND BT.STATUS <> 'D' AND DT.STATUS <> 'D'
